authority: OWNER_BLOCKER_CLEARANCE.md §H2 (signed BBrose 2026-08-15), activated via h2_design_request_pipeline_pointer.json after §I acceptance
purpose: The contract every design request (brief) is validated against before the pipeline runs. BBrose submits a brief; the engine harvests web inspiration and generates ORIGINAL candidates. Measurements and product information arrive AT REQUEST TIME as inputs of the brief.
THE_RULE: A missing field is resolved IN-REQUEST: either ask the owner within the same request cycle, or take a web-derived rough number and mark it tier PRIOR with source provenance. A missing field may NEVER become a standing owner-side blocker, may never park in a clearance document, and may never accumulate in a launcher. (Owner ruling §H2: per-request INPUTS, never standing blockers.)

request_id.description: Slug; becomes the directory docs/roadmap/palt_h2/<request_id>/ holding the ledger, candidates, and contact sheet.

category.description: Product category driving the web search, e.g. 'eyeshadow palette packaging'

physical_measurements.description: Every dimension the artwork is parametric on. Empty array is VALID only if deliverables need no geometry (then record why).

tier.description: MEASURED = owner-supplied (calipers, spec sheet in hand). PRIOR = web-derived rough number, usable immediately, superseded in place when a MEASURED value arrives.

source.description: MEASURED: who measured / which record. PRIOR: the URL it came from.

deliverables_wanted.description: e.g. 'lid artwork direction candidates + contact sheet', 'label sheet', 'editable .ai emission'

set_face.description: Default 'Crimson Text (OFL, SET_FACE per C1 acceptance)' — brief may override

colour_family.description: Default 'PANTONE 621 C / 627 C family (measured-Lab-verified sRGB: ground 207,224,216; deep ink 17,50,44)' — brief may override

taste.description: Recorded owner taste default: QUIET-MINIMAL — the owner chose minimal-central C3 over the advisor-recommended bold C1 (section_e_owner_picks_ingestion.json). At least one generated candidate always honours this.

overrides.description: Anything in this brief that overrides a brand default, stated explicitly

quantity_allocation.description: Optional: units, markets, allocation notes. Missing → resolve in-request or mark N/A.

inspiration_notes.description: Free text: moods, references, directions the owner already likes or forbids

in_request_resolutions.description: Audit trail of THE_RULE firing: every field that was missing at submission and how it was resolved in-request.

pipeline_stages_downstream_of_a_valid_br: 1. HARVEST — real web searches (Pinterest, Dribbble, Behance, GitHub, general image/web) for the category and mood → inspiration_ledger.json under docs/roadmap/palt_h2/<request_id>/; 0 entries = stage FAILED
2. GENERATE — 4-6 ORIGINAL candidates from scratch (SVG-first, renderable previews); each records which ledger entries inspired it; at least one quiet/minimal; inspired-by never copied
3. CONTACT SHEET — one review board PNG, all candidates side by side; the owner picks from artifacts; the pick is design authority
originality_rule: Web material contributes IDEAS (mood, composition class, colour feeling, typographic attitude) with provenance recorded per entry. No traced, reproduced, or closely-derived artwork, ever. Each ledger entry carries an originality note stating what idea was taken and what was NOT taken.
